ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_scaled_exp_weighted_combined_margin
ir.intuition: To break similarity with prior candidates and enrich the margin signal, I replaced the linear combination of (log_prob difference, cost_gap, and advantage_gap) with a nonlinear softplus transformation on scaled log_prob differences, combined with a weighted sum of cost_gap and a tanh-transformed advantage_gap. This adds nonlinearity and asymmetry, softening large log_prob margins and bounding advantage_gap influence. I also normalized weights properly and kept pairwise signals as required. This design uses multiple quality signals (log_prob_w, log_prob_l, cost_gap, advantage_gap) and maintains the weighted average aggregation with clamping for numerical stability.
ir.pseudocode:
margin_logprob = softplus(beta * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))
adv_mod = tanh(delta * advantage_gap)
margin = clamp(margin_logprob + eta * cost_gap + zeta * adv_mod, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(margin)
if weight:
  loss = sum(loss * weight) / (sum(weight) + 1e-8)
else:
  loss = mean(loss)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 1.5))
    eta = float(extra.get('eta', 0.6))
    delta = float(extra.get('delta', 0.9))
    zeta = float(extra.get('zeta', 0.4))
    margin_logprob = ops.softplus(ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), beta))
    adv_mod = ops.tanh(ops.mul(advantage_gap, delta))
    margin_raw = ops.add(ops.add(margin_logprob, ops.mul(cost_gap, eta)), ops.mul(adv_mod, zeta))
    margin = ops.clamp(margin_raw, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin))
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
        denom = ops.add(ops.sum(weight), 1e-8)
        normalized_loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), denom)
    else:
        normalized_loss = ops.mean(loss)
    return normalized_loss
